name: chapterrewind
description: A reading companion web app designed for book lovers who need a quick refresher before diving back into a story.  Whether you've taken a break between books in the series or just want a quick summary before the sequel drops, ChapterRewind helps you catch up with AI-powered summaries and video recaps — all in one place.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
